letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every cool breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. Though the calendar flips to another day, my heart still skips when I hear your laugh—our love feels forever fresh, like the first bloom of spring. You’re my cutie, my confidante, my endless inspiration. Thank you for turning ordinary moments into golden memories; I can’t wait for the next adventure we’ll create together, hand in hand.
poem:
In every desert wind, I hear your sigh,  
And in the monsoon’s kiss, our spirits fly.  
Together we dance through time’s sweet rhyme,  
Love’s melody—eternal, yours and mine.
